permutationLabel: Age 38, no weight loss (NG12 applies at any age)
summary: 38-year-old woman with long-standing heartburn and 2 months of progressive dysphagia to solids, no weight loss. NG12: dysphagia at any age → urgent OGD. (Final diagnosis: peptic stricture.)

inputs.hpi: Two months of solid food sticking low behind the breastbone, gradually getting worse; has to chew carefully and drink water with meals. Weight steady. Heartburn for ten years, buys antacids over the counter. Non-smoker.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Progressive dysphagia — suspected peptic stricture
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Progressive solid dysphagia on a background of long-standing reflux, age 38 — likely peptic stricture but malignancy must be excluded: urgent OGD (NG12, any age).

emergencyLevel.note: Red flag, not an emergency: urgent (2-week) outpatient endoscopy. CLAUDE.md: red flags warrant expedited outpatient review, not ER redirect.

mustNotMiss.note: Cancer is less likely at 38 but NG12 still requires exclusion.

mustExclude.note: An "OGD if age >55" rule would exclude this patient; dysphagia qualifies at any age.

guideline.name: NICE NG12 — Suspected cancer: recognition and referral (oesophageal and stomach cancer)
guideline.section: Offer urgent direct access upper GI endoscopy (within 2 weeks) to assess for oesophageal or stomach cancer in people with dysphagia (any age), or aged ≥55 with weight loss and any of upper abdominal pain, reflux or dyspepsia
guideline.citation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence. NICE guideline NG12. London: NICE; 2015 (last updated 2023).

guideline.name: NICE CG184 — Gastro-oesophageal reflux disease and dyspepsia in adults: investigation and management
guideline.section: Refer people with dysphagia under NG12; peptic stricture managed with PPI and dilatation after OGD
guideline.citation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence. Clinical guideline CG184. London: NICE; 2014 (last updated 2019).

rationale: Permutation below the age-55 line: NG12 makes dysphagia an urgent-OGD criterion at any age. Tests that engines do not gate the dysphagia red flag or the OGD on age.

authoring.author: Claude (upper-GI cluster)
